method: Summon • Demon Parade • Wanted Quests • Dispatch

skills.name: Living Dead (活死人/死人化)
skills.line: Souls of the underworld, hear my call!
skills.description: Shiro Mujou focuses the power of the Underworld to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK. Also has a 100% base chance of inflicting the target with 40% of Heal Down, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Soul Hunt (魂狩/魂狩り)
skills.line: The time has come for me to send you to the underworld!
skills.description: When a non-summoned enemy is KO'd, Shiro Mujou's move bar is increased by 50%. ;Upon Usage :Shiro Mujou summons 1 White Ghost where each enemy was KO'd. Each White Ghost will sacrifice itself to attack all enemies on its next turn, dealing indirect damage equal to 100% of its inherited ATK. :Each White Ghost inherits 10% of Shiro Mujou's HP and and 50% of his ATK. When a White Ghost occupies the spot of a KO'd enemy, they cannot be revived.

upgrades.text: Inherited HP and ATK increases to 15% and 60%.
Inherited HP and ATK increases to 20% and 70%.
Inherited HP and ATK increases to 25% and 80%.
Inherited HP and ATK increases to 30% and 90%.

skills.name: Hands of Hell (无常夺命/無常の命取り)
skills.line: Vengeful souls, drag these foul beings to the underworld!
skills.description: Shiro Mujou summons cursed hands from hell to attack all enemies 3 consecutive times, dealing damage equal to 32% of his ATK with each hit. Also inflicts them with Life Steal, which deals indirect damage equal to 158% of his ATK at the end of turn, lasts for 1 turn. ; : ;Life Steal (命を奪う) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Deals indirect damage equal at the end of the target's turn.

upgrades.text: Increases the duration of Life Steal to 2 turns.

bio.condition: With Shiro Mujou clear stage 5 of any Evo zone (solo).
Team Shiro Mujou with another player's Kuro Mujou and clear any zone 10 times.
